title: USI Academic Staff
description: The International Relations and Study Abroad Service supports USI’s academic staff by facilitating and promoting activities related to the university’s internationalization efforts.

blocks.html: The International Relations and Study Abroad Service supports USI’s academic staff by facilitating and promoting activities related to the university’s internationalization efforts.

items.title: Research or Teaching Stays Abroad
items.html: Participation in mobility periods at partner universities through the SEMP program (or the possibility of hosting colleagues under the same programs). Additional information on academic staff mobility is available here.

items.title: Establishing International Agreements
items.html:
Consultation and administrative support for initiating procedures aimed at signing various types of international agreements. Agreements concerning research collaborations are managed by the Research Service.

The main definitions and internal procedures to be followed are described here: https://www.usi.ch/en/university/info/relint/international-relations/international-cooperation-agreements

items.title: International Relations Commission
items.html:
Each faculty has a representative on the International Relations.
The dedicated page is accessible here: https://www.usi.ch/en/university/info/relint/commission

items.title: Hosting researchers
items.html:
Faculty members interested in hosting researchers may refer to the following programs managed by the International Relations and Study Abroad Service:

  • Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships (ESKAS)
  • Scholars at Risk (SAR)

For visiting researchers not affiliated with a specific program, please refer to the website: www.usi.ch/en/universita/info/relint/informazioni-specifiche/ricercatori-in-visita
